name: autosdk-vscode
description: Edit, run, and build AutoSDK scripts for a TrollStore-installed iOS app

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Connection inspection remains available, but running or deploying workspace scripts and starting local helpers requires trust.

commands.title: AutoSDK: Send Current Script to Device

autosdk.debugUrl.description: Direct Wi-Fi or USB-forwarded WebSocket URL for the iPhone's AutoSDK debug server.

autosdk.connectionTimeout.description: Milliseconds to wait for a debug command response.

autosdk.iproxyPath.description: iproxy executable name or absolute path used by the managed USB tunnel.

autosdk.usbDevicePort.description: AutoSDK debug-server port on the iPhone forwarded by iproxy.

autosdk.usbDeviceUdid.description: Optional iPhone UDID passed to iproxy when more than one device is connected.

autosdk.iproxyUdidStyle.description: Use modern '-u UDID' arguments, or legacy trailing-UDID syntax for old iproxy builds.

autosdk.repositoryPath.description: Local AutoSDK repository path used by the GitHub CLI build command.

autosdk.repository.description: GitHub owner/repository. Leave empty to detect it from the local Git checkout.

autosdk.workflow.description: GitHub Actions workflow used to build the TrollStore IPA.

autosdk.workflowRef.description: Optional branch or tag passed to the GitHub Actions workflow.

autosdk.artifactName.description: GitHub Actions artifact containing the IPA.

autosdk.buildTimeout.description: Maximum number of seconds to wait for the remote IPA build.

scripts.check: node --check extension.js && node --check coalescing-runner.js && node --check connection-settings.js && node --check device-client.js && node --check inspector-input.js && node --check process-lifecycle.js && node --check script-tools.js && node --check usb-tunnel.js && node --check inspector-view.js && node --check media/inspector.js
